highlights.title: More accurate reading positions
highlights.description: EPUB notes open at the right position, including repeated text and selections across line breaks. Delayed PDF text no longer replaces your current selection.

highlights.title: Keep notes when saving or retranslating
highlights.description: Repeated save actions no longer create duplicate notes. Existing translation notes stay intact if retranslation cannot start.

highlights.title: Handle interrupted AI replies correctly
highlights.description: Fixed custom Anthropic proxy URLs. Interrupted replies are no longer saved as successful, and fast fallback does not include unfinished deep text.

highlights.title: Keep sync and model settings current
highlights.description: Changing your WeRead API key discards the old account’s sync results. Late model-list responses no longer overwrite edits made while loading.

highlights.title: Reading activity stays on its actual day
highlights.description: Reopening an old article no longer moves its notes, discussions, and distillations to today. Reading streaks follow the actual activity dates.

highlights.title: More reliable keys and app locking
highlights.description: Legacy keys awaiting migration survive a temporarily unavailable keyring. After key removal or a backup restore, the app no longer uses old credentials. Locking closes discussion and distillation windows.
